program.intent: Pack timestamp and timezone offset into one integer for exact rendering.
program.code:
def forward(groups):
    day, month, year, hour, minute, second, sp, offset = groups
    text = f"{day.zfill(2)}/{month}/{year} {hour}:{minute}:{second} {offset}"
    dt = datetime.strptime(text, '%d/%b/%Y %H:%M:%S %z')
    micros = int(dt.timestamp() * 1000000)
    return {'stored': [micros], 'layout': [len(sp)]}

def inverse(record):
    micros = record['stored'][0]
    layout = record.get('layout', [])
    sp_len = layout[0]
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(micros / 1000000, tz=datetime.timezone.utc).astimezone()
    day = dt.strftime('%d')
    month = dt.strftime('%b')
    year = dt.strftime('%Y')
    time = dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
    offset = dt.strftime('%z')
    return f"[{day}/{month}/{year}:{time}{' ' * sp_len}{offset}]"
